independent_computation.step_0_scenario_decode: The scenario name decodes entirely from cached data: 'syndra' = Syndra; '120' = the Splinters of Wrath stack count, which data/champions.json Syndra P and data/champion-audit/batch-6.json both identify as the Transcendence capstone ('At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%'); 'custom_order' = a non-default cast/level order option. No src/, tests/, scripts/ or git history was consulted.
independent_computation.step_1_ability_identity: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q ('Dark Sphere') is the only Syndra source with damageType MAGIC_DAMAGE that can produce 713 as a single instance. Its single damage row is 'Magic Damage' = [90,125,160,195,230] + [70]% AP. The event's damage_type 'magic' matches Q's declared damageType MAGIC_DAMAGE; phase 'ability' matches an ability cast (Q castTime 'none', cooldown 7 s, effectRadius 210, targetRange 800).
independent_computation.step_2_ap_with_transcendence: P (Transcendent) at 120 splinters multiplies total AP by 1.15. Solving the Q formula for AP: AP = (713 - 230) / 0.70 = 690.0, and 690.0 / 1.15 = 600.0 exactly. So the event is Q at rank 5 with 600 AP pre-buff and 690 AP after the 120-splinter Transcendence buff.
independent_computation.step_3_forward_check: 230 + 0.70 x 690 = 230 + 483 = 713.0 magic damage. Uniqueness sweep over all five Q ranks x round pre-buff AP values (400/500/600/700/800, each x1.15) yields exactly one hit within +/-0.6: rank 5, AP_pre 600 -> 713.0. Competing Syndra sources at AP 690 do not reach 713 as a single magic instance: E = 200 + 0.60x690 = 614.0; W = 190 + 0.65x690 = 638.5 magic (its transcendent add-on is true damage, a separate type); R per sphere = 160 + 0.20x690 = 298.0. Fitting W to 713 needs AP 804.6 (pre-buff 699.7, not round) and would carry source 'W'. So {damage 713.0, magic, source Q} is self-consistent and uniquely determined.
independent_computation.step_4_mitigation: 713.0 is exactly the pre-mitigation figure, so the recorded event is consistent with a manual target at 0 effective magic resistance (or with the event log carrying raw damage). Under docs/math-foundations.md 2.1, m(R) = 100/(100+R); any positive post-penetration MR would scale 713.0 to a non-integer (e.g. MR 30 -> 548.5, MR 100 -> 356.5), none of which the leaf shows.
independent_computation.step_5_timing_plausibility: The cast epoch t = 10.0 is consistent with the sourced cooldown data. Q base cooldown is 7 s (data/champions.json Syndra.Q.cooldown, rechargeRate 7) and Syndra R's passive explicitly grants Dark Sphere '10/20/30 ability haste', so Q is a haste-scaled cooldown. Using the audited identity cd' = cd x 100/(100+AH) (docs/math-foundations.md 5, 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)'), 40 total Q ability haste gives cd' = 7 x 100/140 = 5.0 s exactly, i.e. cast epochs 0.0, 5.0, 10.0, ... under the shared-timeline renewal schedule of 1.1 ('an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress'). At 120 splinters Q additionally holds up to 2 stocked charges ('Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2'; data/champion-audit/batch-6.json models this as the synthetic 'Q2' slot), which can only add Q casts, never remove them. A Q instance at t = 10.0 is therefore schedulable; nothing in the cached data forbids it.

caveats: The evidence tree deliberately excludes the scenario definition (it lives outside data/ and docs/math-foundations.md), so AP 600 pre-buff, Q rank 5 and total Q ability haste 40 were reconstructed by inversion, not read. The inversion is exact and unique across all five Q ranks at round AP, which is why it is treated as confirmatory rather than assumed.

The cached wiki record carries `affectedByCdr: false` on Syndra Q's cooldown block, which contradicts the same champion's R passive expressing Q's cooldown reduction in ability-haste units. This is flagged as a wiki-data artifact; if an engine honored it literally, Q epochs would be 0/7/14 rather than 0/5/10. It does not change the damage magnitude of a Q instance, which is what this leaf's value asserts.
verdict_rationale: 713.0 magic from source Q is exactly and uniquely reproducible from the cached wiki numbers (Dark Sphere rank 5 base 230 + 70% AP, with the 120-splinter Transcendence 1.15x AP multiplier giving 690 AP). The prior state (event absent) records no Q instance where the sourced cooldown/charge data permits one, and cannot be reconciled with any cached formula. Every field of the new leaf - damage, damage_type, phase, source - checks out against data/champions.json; the timestamp is consistent with the audited cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) identity at 40 Q ability haste.
